shortDescription: The Testimonial Persona Quote section creates impactful social proof displays using large profile pictures alongside customer quotes. It supports single or multiple testimonials in a slider format. Each testimonial includes name, position, company, quote text, profile picture, and optional company logo. The distinctive image styles (circle, square, speech bubble) add visual variety. This section works best when featuring key customers, partners, or influencers whose faces and stories build trust.
